interfaces.name: IncrementalVerificationPlanner

signatures.module_function: create_verification_plan(repository_state, invalidation_plan, context_pack, patch_delta, policy, *, cache=None, adapter=None) -> VerificationPlan

planning_properties: Deterministic and side-effect free; never mutates receipt cache tombstones.
Exact-key cache lookup only; no semantic approximation.
Cross-checks patch base against repository/invalidation/context tree and semantic roots.
Broadens under uncertainty; forces human review for unbound sandbox, policy conflict, or scope crossing.
Importing the module performs no I/O.
interfaces.aae_reuse: Plan incremental checks for each admitted mutant; never replace full-suite policy when uncertainty/high risk requires broader coverage.

interfaces.name: VerificationReceiptCache
production_admission_rules: Every hit re-derives key identity, content CID, kind, and terminal status.
Production success terminals are only passed and proved.
stale, simulated, timeout, unavailable, invalid, malformed, kind-mismatched, key-mismatched, and corrupt candidates never satisfy production.
Cache presence is never authority; immutable receipt bytes are never mutated in place.
Concurrent writers merge via generation CAS retry and never overwrite peers.
interfaces.aae_reuse: Reuse unaffected proof/test units only after complete cache-key validation; temporary proof forests must not replace canonical seals.

interfaces.name: VerificationExecutor

signatures.module_function: execute_verification_plan(verification_plan, *, observed_identities=None, post_observed_identities=None, cancellation=None, step_bindings=None, advisory_key_cids=(), human_review_required=None, model_route_decision=None, routing_hints=None, cache=None, process_runner=None, resource_scheduler=None, host_snapshot=None, check_runner=None, check_runners=None, require_resource_lease=...) -> VerificationExecutionResult

production_acceptance_rules: Every non-advisory required receipt key must be present and successful (passed/proved).
Advisory keys may remain unresolved without upgrading them.
interfaces.aae_reuse: Execute predicted incremental checks, broaden survivors per policy, and emit plan-bound receipts/commitments for each mutant.

interfaces.name: VerificationProcessRunner

signatures.constructor: VerificationProcessRunner(*, resource_scheduler=None, host_snapshot=None, popen_factory=..., clock=..., sleep=...)

isolation_properties: Explicit argv only; no shell interpolation of untrusted paths.
Hermetic environment builder strips production credentials and ambient secrets.
ResourceScheduler lease required for admitted runs; capacity exhaustion is typed rejection.
Process-tree fencing supports cancellation without accepting late receipts as success.
interfaces.aae_reuse: Network-disabled mutant test/prover execution under disposable sandboxes; cancellation and timeout map to terminal statuses.

signatures.module_function: choose_model_route(context_pack, verification_plan, prior_attempts, available_models, policy, *, routing_hints=None) -> ModelRouteDecision

routing_rules: Selects capability class only; vendor/provider/model resolution is out of scope.
available_models is provider-neutral inventory of tier, context limit, locality, and availability.
When the required tier is unavailable, routing does not downgrade; returns human_review_required.

Fail-closed human review precedes any model route for unresolved authority, unmodeled high-risk effects, scope crossings, proof/test conflict, unsafe context, non-reproducible environment, or pending mandatory full/broader suite.
Importing the module performs no I/O and never invokes a model provider.

interfaces.name: IsolatedWorktree
isolation_properties: Detached worktree at a pinned base commit/tree.
Patch preimage validation and scope enforcement before apply.
Fence and phase journal for recovery; no ambient host checkout mutation of the operator tree.
Cleanup may only remove owned disposable worktrees.
interfaces.aae_reuse: Disposable isolated worktrees for mutant materialization; never mutate trusted keys, policy, verifier, benchmark oracle, or promotion authority except in explicit verifier fixtures.

interfaces.aae_reuse: Resource admission for mutation workers and campaign parallelism; capacity exhaustion is typed rejection, not silent oversubscription.

interfaces.name: MutationLedger
rules: Reusable file-lineage evidence only; not an assurance campaign engine.
Does not generate semantic mutants, expected-detection sets, gap taxonomies, or promotion flows.
AAE must not rebrand MutationLedger as AdversarialAssuranceEngine.
interfaces.aae_reuse: Optional lineage recording of applied mutant artifacts; campaign planning/execution remains a separate AAE package.

interfaces.name: FormalVerificationPolicy
policy_rules: Contains no prover integration; selects assurance and fallback requirements only.
unsupported, unavailable, timed_out, inconclusive, and missing never satisfy an assurance requirement.
Configured fallback may satisfy a requirement only when the matching rule allows fallback and every named validation has an explicit passing result.
Rollout transitions and emergency overrides are bounded content-addressed receipts.
RolloutMode.SHADOW is a policy rollout gate, not paired semantic shadowing and not AAE campaign completion.
interfaces.aae_reuse: Risk-selected proof/policy gates for remediation promotion; never treat infrastructure failure as proof success.

interfaces.name: ProgramAnalysisZKP
interfaces.scope_statement: Trace validity proves only commitment openings and supported deterministic trace transitions terminating in the committed supported result.
zk_nonclaims: Not a substitute for released IncrementalProofSealer full-checkpoint or delta seals.
Not proof of repository correctness, mutation-set completeness, or specification completeness.
Simulated/shadow backends cannot promote to production attestation.
Does not establish direct execution unless the underlying proof/observation does.
interfaces.aae_reuse: Scoped program-trace ZK contract surface for controlled fixtures; campaign seal remains release-gated and separate.

interfaces.name: DatasetsZkAttestation
zk_nonclaims: Receipt-bound attestation is not an IncrementalProofSealer campaign seal.
Backend unavailability is typed, not remapped to passed/proved.
interfaces.aae_reuse: Optional receipt-bound ZK attestation adapter when datasets backend is present; never overclaim as full campaign seal.

commitment.note: Structural Merkle commitment over admitted verification receipts. Signed receipts are not proof of execution without trusted issuer; structural validation is not cryptographic validation of underlying execution. Cannot substitute for a released full-checkpoint or delta proof sealer.

verification_evaluation.role: Selected-versus-full-suite evaluation over controlled fixtures; measures incremental cost vs full verification counterfactual.
